parsed.note_claim: The surrendering forces in Mokha and Hays are local Yemeni allied fighters, not Saudi national military troops.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: Tarek Saleh, who heads the Yemeni National Resistance Forces that controlled Mocha, said he moved his command centre "to a safe location" to regroup.
parsed.reason: The page identifies the forces that controlled and retreated from Mocha as Yemeni National Resistance Forces under Tarek Saleh, and mentions Saudi Arabia only in the context of airstrikes, supporting the note's distinction between local Yemeni fighters and Saudi national troops.
